title: Rubia
summary: A rigged character with full skeleton and skinning, shown live in the realtime viewer with an idle animation. Drag to orbit, switch to Pose to drag the hands and feet with IK, and toggle wireframe or read the mesh stats.

seo.title: Rubia — rigged character
seo.description: A rigged character shown live in a realtime WebGL viewer with skeleton, skinning, an idle animation, wireframe, and mesh stats.

interactive.note: Live WebGL viewer — drag to orbit. The rigged character renders in real time with an idle animation; switch to Pose for drag-to-pose IK on the hands and feet, and the inspector exposes wireframe and mesh stats.
